done_when: The three tests pass in five repeated runs each on Linux, and forge-next.yml's Windows jobs pass on the fix branch, each still checking the behaviour it was written for
why: Three Forge tests fail often without a code change, each costing a 15 to 30 minute CI rerun: tests/test_parallel_worker_crash_keeps_failed_names.py::test_1 on Linux (pytest-xdist INTERNALERROR 'cannot send (already closed?)', about one run in three), and on Windows tests/test_windows_stdin_bytes.py::test_1 (a test sitecustomize patches Popen._save_input, which Windows lacks) and tests/test_board_first_screen_reads_whole.py::test_1 (its Playwright run times out and the assertion message adds None)
